title: SQL FCI chaos: kill sqlservr -> WSFC recovery
description: The nexus-cli chaos verb for the SQL Server FCI: hard-kill sqlservr.exe on the active node; WSFC restarts/fails the SQL resource over; poll to green.

observe.what: the observed impact during the kill window, then Recovered=true once the FCI virtual server answers again

whatProves: WSFC health-monitoring detects the SQL resource failure and auto-recovers the single FCI instance (restart-in-place or failover); the cluster returns to green unattended.
